m: The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} and finds a tiny *emperor* roasting marshmallows over a roaring *campfire*. "Put it out!" yells the Sheriff, but the emperor just fans the flames with his crown. Shingles start to **burn**, the flagpole starts to **burn**, and the Sheriff's hat goes up like a birthday candle.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} and lands on a giant *kicking foot* that boots a wooden *set square* clean across the gallery. It sails past mummies and dinosaurs. The Juggler sprints after it with a tape measure, unrolling it yard after yard, shouting out the **distance**: what a **distance**, all the way to the gift shop.

The {Tsar} storms up the {Staircase} of the {Island} palace, waving a jousting *lance* like a pair of scissors. A huge velvet *robe* hangs at the top, and he slashes at it until he has **cut out** a perfect gingerbread-man shape. His tailor weeps, then asks him to **cut out** the sleeves too.

The {Pirate} swings onto the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange}, where a *standing person* is hanging up a heavy *nameboard* that says BANK. The Pirate lands on one end of it. Everything begins to **lean**: the board, the person, the chimney, the whole building. Bankers inside **lean** sideways at their desks and their coins slide into the sea.

The {Firefighter} hauls a hose up the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and meets a *cashier* sitting at a till made of *bamboo*. "No entry without a ticket," she says, and paints a strange **sign** on the Firefighter's helmet. Instantly every lifeguard salutes. That painted **sign** opens every door, even the one to the diving board.

The {Yogi} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut, where a sea monster is snoring. A little *man* with a silver *hairpin* steps forward, pulls out the pin and jabs it, like a sword, at the monster's nose. The monster flees, squeaking. "So **brave**," gasps the Yogi, and from then on the **brave** little man wears the hairpin as a medal.

The {Chef} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Pool} carrying an *ox horn*, and a shiny green *bug* lands on its tip. The Chef reaches out to **touch** it. Zap! The bug sparks like a doorbell and every swimmer leaps out of the water. Now nobody dares **touch** anything, not even the rubber duck.

The {King} slides down the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} into a tiny classroom. A *small speech bubble* floats above the blackboard, drawing pictures of *fruit*: apple, pear, banana. The King has to sit at a desk and copy them all, because today's **lesson** is fruit. The bubble rings a bell and starts the next **lesson**: more fruit.

The {Juggler} pops up through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring}, still juggling, and the whole crowd rises in a giant *salute*. The champion bows. The referee bows. Even the bell bows. The Juggler is so shocked by all this **respect** that he drops every ball, and the crowd salutes again out of pure **respect**.

The {King} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building next to a *dog* whose loud *chatter* has turned into howling. The dog starts to **cry**, and its tears pour down the drainpipe and fill the swimming pool. The King starts to **cry** too, and soon the water spills over the diving boards.

The {Dentist} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} lighthouse and finds a film *director* shouting at a *standing heart* wearing sunglasses. "Feel it! Beat louder!" The heart thumps once, twice, then suddenly nods. At last it **understands** the scene. The Dentist claps, because now he too can **understand** why the heart was crying.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels up the {Staircase} of the {Stadium} and finds a *miser* building a **wall** out of *soil*, one mean spoonful at a time, so nobody can see the game for free. She kicks it, but the mud just grows taller. By halftime the **wall** reaches the scoreboard and the miser charges a coin to peek over it.

The {Shepherd} is counting sheep on the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house when a *dragon* in a silk *robe* swoops down. It snatches every towel, every bucket, every ice cream. It's a **raid**! The Shepherd chases it with his crook, but the dragon is already planning its next **raid** on the sandcastles.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} and lands beside a *town crier* ringing an enormous bell. "Oyez! I **summon** the horses!" he bellows. At once, three hundred horses gallop up the tower stairs and squeeze into the room. The Jockey begs him to stop, but he keeps ringing to **summon** more.

The {Firefighter} trips on the {Staircase} of the {Spa} and gets tangled in a giant *fishing net* hanging there. The manager scoops her up and dangles her over the hot tub to **punish** her for running indoors. Every time she wriggles, the net dips her in again. That is how they **punish** you at the spa.

The {Shepherd} waits on the {Staircase} of the {Piazza} when a *standing person* bursts through the crowd holding a pair of blacksmith's *tongs*. She snatches a burning pie off a stall and saves a lost lamb from a pigeon gang. Everyone cheers the masked **hero**. The Shepherd gets her autograph, which just says "**hero**".

The {Tailor} stitches on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} and drops his sewing *nail*. It falls into a vast stone *cliff*-sided **hall** where a thousand fans are waiting. The nail pings, echoes, and rattles round the walls for ten minutes. The whole **hall** cheers, thinking it is the starting bell.

The {Baker} falls through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Island} and finds a crowd of crabs raising one *shading hand* each, peering at him. Then they **bow**, all together, claws to the sand. The Baker nervously bows back. The crabs **bow** lower, the Baker bows lower, until everyone is face down in the sand.

The {Cheerleader} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café}, where a *workbench* is covered in tiny wooden mice. With one *puff of breath* she blows sawdust off a mouse that can dance, juggle and spin. The cats go wild. "So **skilful**!" they purr, and they order her to make a **skilful** robot ball of yarn too.

The {Tsar} topples through the {Trapdoor} into the {Hut}, where a *standing person* reads a huge *rulebook* aloud: "Rule one: always walk on the left **side**." The Tsar shuffles to the left. "Rule two: now the other **side**." He shuffles right. By rule ninety he is spinning like a top on his own **side**.

The {Hunter} gallops up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} at *dawn*, holding a *leather strap* like a lasso. At the top, a window opens onto **Korea**: mountains, kimchi jars and a pop band waving. The Hunter lassoes the band's microphone and sings along. Every morning at dawn, the strap pulls him to **Korea** again.

The {Magician} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} wearing a tall *brimmed hat*. The hat starts to **emit** smoke, then bubbles, then pigeons, then a brass band. Rabbits pour out of it like toothpaste. The Magician presses down on the brim, but the hat just keeps on going to **emit** more and more.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} hut and lands on a *standing person*, who is being chased by a *debt collector* waving a giant bill. "Pay your **debt**!" The Jockey lends him a horseshoe. Now the debt collector chases the Jockey instead, because the **debt** has jumped over to him.

The {Magician} floats down through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} wrapped in a *long veil* that ripples like smoke. She drifts across the ballroom, so **graceful** that the chandeliers sway in time. The butler tries to copy her, trips on the veil, and pirouettes into the punch bowl, almost **graceful**.

The {Robot} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} hut carrying a *cauldron*, and a little *bug* in it starts to stir. Steam rises. The robot's metal knees begin to **melt**, then its elbows, then its bolts, until it is a silver puddle. The bug sips the puddle and says, "Watching robots **melt** is my favourite soup."

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swan Pond} and lands among swans, each wearing a *string of coins*. His *standing heart* jumps in fright at first, but now he visits every day and he is **used to** it. The swans jingle, the coins clink, he naps through it all. He is so **used to** the noise.

The {Shepherd} wanders into the {Basement} of the {Stadium} and finds a huge *feast* laid out on the locker benches: roast chickens, jellies, towers of dumplings. He tucks in with both hands, and the sheep join him. Upstairs the match goes on, but down here everyone **enjoys** themselves, slurping, burping, and learning to **enjoy** every crumb.

The {Dentist} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} hut, where a *lance* is propped against the wall with a *strange mask* hanging on its tip. He pulls it on. It fits perfectly. He decides to **wear** it for every patient, and now they all **wear** masks too, so nobody knows who is pulling out whose teeth.

The {Tailor} runs up the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} hut with a tape measure, chased by a *schoolkid* who won't stand still. The **child** wriggles, giggles, and leaps into the lagoon in a half-sewn suit. The Tailor dives after the **child** and ends up measuring a dolphin instead.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} when a *prowling dog* sniffs at the *wart* on his nose. The Yogi doesn't move: **as if** he were a statue. The dog licks the wart. The Yogi keeps still, **as if** made of stone, until the dog gives up and paddles away.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} treehouse with a soup pot and meets a *rider* sitting on an elephant. "Hop on!" The Chef jumps up and they **ride** through the vines, soup sloshing everywhere. Monkeys leap aboard to **ride** too, and soon the elephant is carrying a whole kitchen.

The {Gardener} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Water Park} clutching a green *jade tablet*. A *helping hand* shoots out of the water slide and snatches it, then tries to **hang** it on a slippery tube. It slides off. The hand tries again and again, until finally the gardener himself is left to **hang** from the slide.

The {Juggler} tumbles into the {Basement} of the {Stadium} and finds a *big man* guarding a golden trophy taller than himself. "Juggle twenty eggs and win the **prize**!" The Juggler juggles twenty-one. The big man bursts into tears, hands over the **prize**, and is buried under falling egg yolk.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a party where a *town crier* runs around tying *silk thread* from guest to guest. "May I **introduce** the Sheriff!" he shouts, and ties her to a duchess. Then he ties the duchess to a goat. He has to **introduce** everyone, so soon all of them are knotted together.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} into a pile of blankets, where a small *child* is wrapping herself in one more quilt, then another, then another. She is now so **thick** she cannot fit through the door. The Hunter pushes, she bounces back like a mattress, wrapped in **thick**, thicker, thickest wool.

The {Zookeeper} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} hut holding a spool of *silk thread*, and a *follower* grabs the loose end and climbs straight up it. The thread goes **vertical**, stiff as a flagpole. More followers climb up after her. Soon there is a **vertical** line of people reaching from the lagoon to the clouds.

The {Jockey} gallops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and his horse skids into a *hillside* that has slid inside overnight. A guard with a shiny *badge* stands on it, arms crossed, to **block** the way. The Jockey jumps; the guard jumps higher to **block** him. The planes have to take off through the roof.

The {Shepherd} topples through the {Trapdoor} of the {Dunes} hut and a *swift* bird zooms in after him, carrying a *small speech bubble* in its beak. It drops the bubble on his head: "Breaking **news**! The sheep have learned to surf!" Another swift arrives with more **news**, then another, until the sand is covered in headlines.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} into knee-deep *water drops* that have flooded the floor. She has to take one careful *step* at a time to **wade** across the room to the coffee pot. Fish nibble her boots. By the time she **wades** back, the coffee is also full of fish.

The {Chef} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and leaves muddy *footsteps* everywhere. In a frenzy he scrubs them all off, then makes one last *cut* through every cobweb and onion. The cleaning is so **thorough** that the hut squeaks. Even the mice have been sliced, washed and labelled, which is a bit too **thorough**.

The {King} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} beside a *drying rack* hung with wet newspapers. With a *standing knife* he trims each page and flings them to the crowd below. "We **publish** today!" Pigeons carry copies across the city, and the King decides to **publish** a new paper every hour.

The {Jockey} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and lands next to an old man's *walking staff* that keeps growing. It shoots up **ten feet** tall and lifts the old man to the ceiling. The Jockey measures it with his whip: exactly **ten feet**, not an inch more, and the old man waves from the rafters.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} with a tray of popcorn kernels and sets it on a *campfire* during a fierce *heatwave*. Pop! Pop! The kernels **explode**, then the oven, then the Baker's hat. The whole tower shakes. Finally the roof itself starts to **explode** into a fountain of buttered popcorn.

The {Wizard} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building when a black *crow* lands on his pointed hat and caws so loudly that the pool water ripples. He tries a spell to turn the **crow** white. It turns into ten black crows. Soon the whole roof is a cawing mat of **crows**.

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and is handed a *war club* by a sergeant. Muddy *footsteps* lead to a mountain of sand to be moved. "Hard **labour**!" Bash, dig, haul. The Yogi does every bit of **labour** in a perfect lotus position, which annoys the sergeant greatly.

The {Magician} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} with tracing paper. A *helping hand* lays the paper over a tray of *young crop* seedlings and begins to **trace** every little leaf with a pencil. The cats lean in, curious, so the hand starts to **trace** the cats as well, whiskers and all.

The {Shepherd} dashes into the {Basement} of the {Beach} house where a muddy *front runner* from the marathon is standing in a bathtub. *Water drops* rain from the ceiling and the Shepherd scrubs him with a sheep. "Must **wash** before the finish line!" They **wash** until the runner gleams, then he sprints off, dripping.

The {Magician} slips into the {Basement} of the {Spa}, where a *king* sits on a *horse* in a mud bath. The horse spits out a striped stone: a polished **agate**. The king gasps. The horse spits out another **agate**, then a hundred, until the mud bath is full of glossy striped pebbles.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Swan Pond} carrying a *kebab* skewered right through a pink *heart*. The swans hiss. The heart moans, "Oh, I **suffer**!" The Hunter pulls out the skewer, but now the kebab moans too. Everyone at the pond has to **suffer** their wailing until sunset.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} and a *woman* hands her a *pinch* of glittery powder. She sprinkles it on the cats, and they start to tap-dance in perfect rows. "**Wonderful**!" shrieks the woman. Another pinch, and the teapots join in. Everything is **wonderful** until the sugar bowl tap-dances off the table.

The {Juggler} bursts through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring} for the grand *finale* and juggles a shower of *gold coins*. Each coin is polished like a **mirror**, so a thousand tiny Jugglers flash around the ring. The boxer punches the wrong one and hits a giant **mirror** hanging over the ropes, which only makes more Jugglers.

The {Chef} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} holding a frying pan with a *double sun* sizzling in it like two eggs. Each sun opens a little *mouth* and starts to **sing** opera. The pilots stop work. The Chef flips the suns and they **sing** even louder, in harmony, until the planes hum along.

The {Firefighter} stomps up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} to put out a *campfire* someone lit on the landing. Every time she sprays it, a *page* of homework flutters out and lands on her face. Spray, page, spray, page. She is so **annoyed** she starts to growl, and the fire looks **annoyed** too.

The {Cheerleader} flips onto the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange}, where a whole *assembly* of bankers waits with *bamboo* pens. "Everyone **sign** here!" she shouts, and they scribble their names on her pompoms. Then they **sign** her shoes, her megaphone and the chimney, until every brick has a signature.

The {Shepherd} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} and sees a *standing person* floating over the *mountain* behind it, robes fluttering, eating clouds like candyfloss. "I am **immortal**," she says, "I've been here for three thousand years." The Shepherd offers her a sheep. She makes it **immortal** too, and it floats off grazing on stars.

The {Baker} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Beach} house following sandy *footsteps* to a pile of buckets. Under one is a crab trying to *hide*. "Not this one," says the Baker, "**that** one!" He points at the next bucket. Under it, another crab. "No, **that** one!" He points and points at things over there, never here.

The {Firefighter} slides down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and a giant *dollar sign* blocks her path. She tries to pay to swim. The dollar sign shakes its head: **not** today. She offers more money. **Not** enough. In the end she hoses it down, and it shrinks to a cent and rolls into the drain.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} hospital and lands on a *sickbed* parked right on a football *goal line*. A monkey doctor checks him: "This **illness** is serious, you scored an own goal." Nurses in jerseys carry the bed up and down the pitch, but the **illness** only gets worse each time the crowd cheers.

The {Firefighter} crouches in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} as a *standing person* sneaks in carrying a cardboard *square*. Every move the Firefighter makes, the person copies: hose up, helmet off, sneeze. They **imitate** her so well that the pilots salute the wrong one. Even the cardboard square starts to **imitate** her fire engine.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels onto the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} where a *standing person* with a *tilted head* is peering at the crowd. The Cheerleader copies the pose, then the referee, then the audience. The whole arena starts to **tilt**. The ring itself slides to one side, and boxers keep falling out because everything **tilts** a little more.

The {Pirate} drags a *wood slice* up the {Staircase} of the {Island} and paints it with skulls, then fans it dry with a giant paper *fan*. Now it is a **sign board** reading "NO PARROTS". A parrot lands on it at once. The Pirate paints a bigger **sign board**, and ten parrots land on that.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and, at the bottom of a grassy *hillside*, falls into a hidden *trap pit* full of coins. The bank set this **trap** for thieves. The Shepherd shouts for help; a banker peeks over the edge, laughs, and sets another **trap** right beside him.

The {Ninja} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café}, silent as a shadow, carrying a cage with one tiny **bird** inside. The cats spot it. Total chaos: cats leap, cups fly, and the *bird* escapes, perching on the Ninja's head. Now every cat in the café is staring at the Ninja, who freezes, pretending to be a **bird** too.

The {Hunter} is on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} lighthouse when a runaway *cart* comes rolling up. He grabs it with *both hands*, but it is packed with fireworks. **Bang**! The cart explodes, flinging him into the water. **Bang**, bang! Rockets whizz over the lagoon and every fish leaps out to watch.

The {Zookeeper} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and finds every animal sitting at one giant table with a *mouth* and a *nose* drawn on a big group photo. "That's **we**, all of us together!" says the giraffe. The zookeeper squeezes into the frame, and the elephant trumpets, "**We** are family!"

The {Tsar} falls through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Island}, where a *fruit picker* is wading through tall *grass* plucking giant cabbages. She throws one at the Tsar. It lands on his crown. "Eat your **vegetable**!" she says. He refuses, so she throws carrots, leeks and pumpkins, until he is buried in every **vegetable** on the island.

The {Baker} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut, where a tiny *green shoot* is growing in the middle of an iron *gate*. It sneezes, and the gate slams shut. The Baker shoves; it won't open. The shoot giggles and makes every door **close**, then every window, then the Baker's eyes, which **close** for a nap.

The {Firefighter} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} into a muddy *rice field* behind the rides, where a *big man* is pushing a stuck bumper car. He grunts, sweats and pushes with all his might. "**Strive**!" yells the Firefighter, spraying him for encouragement. He keeps on, **striving** until the car shoots forward and loops the rollercoaster.

The {Cheerleader} bursts through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring} and finds a *big man* dancing on the roof of a garden *shed* that someone has put in the middle of the ring. Confetti cannons fire. "Let's **celebrate**!" he roars. The crowd throws streamers, the boxers do the conga, and the shed itself starts to **celebrate** by playing music.

The {Chef} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Hut} kitchen and burns the soup. A *helping hand* waves a white napkin: "**Withdraw**! **Withdraw**!" Every pan, spoon and potato marches backwards out of the door in perfect order. The Chef is left alone with the burnt pot, which also tiptoes away.

The {Lifeguard} plunges through the {Trapdoor} into the {Lake} and finds one huge *eye* floating there, chopping onions. *Water drops* spill down its lid. The **tears** fall so fast that the lake rises. The Lifeguard blows her whistle, but it only cries harder, until she is swimming in **tears** up to her nose.

The {Chef} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Spa} and stuffs a kettle with fresh *grass* from the lawn. He pours boiling water and serves it to the guests: green **tea**. They sip politely. The goats in the garden smell it and storm the spa, demanding **tea** too, with biscuits.

The {Juggler} sneezes on the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house and gets a blazing *fever*. Thermometers pop out of his mouth like party blowers. This **disease** makes everything he juggles get hot too: the balls glow red and the sand turns to glass. The doctor arrives and catches the **disease** at once.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Mint} when a *hog* trots up trailing a red *silk thread* tied to its tail. The other end is tied to the Yogi's toe. "It's **fate**," sighs the hog. They try to untie it; the knot only tightens. They are bound by **fate** forever, and the hog moves in.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} with a sack of seeds. A giant *helping hand* swings over a *footprint field* below and scatters them, one into every footprint. The Baker joins in to **sow** too. Seconds later, sunflowers burst up from every footprint and the soldiers' boots start sprouting as they **sow**.

The {Lifeguard} climbs into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} at night with a mirror and catches the full *moon* in it. She aims it around: the hangar goes **bright** as noon. Planes squint. Bats flee. Pilots put on sunglasses. It is so **bright** that the moon itself blinks and asks her to turn it down.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} into a small *tree* growing out of a mound of *soil* on the bottom. Its roots plug the drain and the water stops dead. "**Stop**!" cries the Dentist to the leaking water, and it obeys. The tree waves a branch: "**Stop** the swimming too." Everyone freezes mid-stroke.

The {Ninja} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Island} hut, where a *woman* is milking a coconut tied with a pink *ribbon*. Fresh **milk** squirts out, into a bucket, onto the Ninja's mask. He tries to escape silently, but slips in the puddle of **milk** and slides straight into the sea.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut juggling a *grain stalk*, an ice cream, a snowball and an autumn leaf. A *child* catches each one in turn. Every catch changes the **season**: spring, summer, autumn, winter. The child grins and throws them back faster, until a new **season** passes every second.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} painting a stone *archway* bright **red**, then slaps a **red** *lid* on top like a cherry. The paint drips down every window. The owners open their curtains and find everything red: the cat, the toast, the tea. The Dentist just keeps on painting.

The {Gardener} hides in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} as a *prowling dog* sniffs between the boats. It sits up and speaks in a giant *quotation* mark: "Woof!" The Gardener writes it down. The **dog** says another quote, then a poem. Soon the Gardener has a whole book by a **dog**.

The {Wizard} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Lake} cottage, where a *lying man* is snoring with a long bushy *fur* thing poking out of his trousers. The Wizard tugs it. It's a **tail**! The man wakes up, wags the **tail**, and knocks the Wizard's hat into the lake.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house for a grand **ceremony**. A *standing person* in a wig, the *judge*, bangs a seashell gavel and announces the winner of the sandcastle contest. Trumpets blow. Crabs throw petals. The Yogi falls asleep halfway through and the whole **ceremony** has to start again.

The {Tailor} creeps across the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} and watches a *standing person* lower a *dugout canoe* from the roof on ropes, piled with buttons. "You **steal** my buttons!" shouts the Tailor. The thief paddles off through the air. The Tailor leaps into another canoe to **steal** them back.

The {Baker} is on the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair}'s big wheel when a *big man* crashes out of the *shrubbery* below and starts to **rush** across the park, dragging candyfloss and balloons. The Baker leaps down to follow. They **rush** past the carousel, through the ghost train and out into traffic, still not knowing why.

The {Jockey} gallops onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building and finds a *king* polishing a tray of *red lacquer*. On it sits one giant **pearl**. The king flicks it and it rolls off the roof, bouncing into the pool. The Jockey dives after it, while the king throws in another **pearl** for fun.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} hut with a salad and finds a *bug* sitting on the lettuce, wearing a tiny chef's hat. The **bug** seizes a fork and starts to cook. Soon a thousand more bugs march up the stairs. The Chef is fired, and the **bug** runs the kitchen.

The {Jockey} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} on his *horse*, which plants its hooves on the bottom and refuses to move. He lights a *candle* and stays the night. Guards come to **station** themselves around him. Morning comes; the horse has taken root. They must **station** a lifeguard on its back.

The {King} falls into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut through a round *hole* in the floor. He peeks through another **hole** in the wall and sees a fish peeking back through a third. Soon the whole room is full of holes, and the King is wearing a **hole**-shaped crown.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house into a *cozy room* with cushions and lamps. She tries the bed: too soft. The hammock: too swingy. Finally the floor mat: exactly **suitable**. She sits in perfect lotus. The crabs agree it is **suitable** too and queue for yoga.

The {Ghost} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} hut and drifts into a jungle of *mugwort*, the grey-green herb. It sniffs it, sneezes, and turns green itself. Villagers burn **mugwort** to chase it away, but the Ghost loves the smell and dances in the smoke, wearing a crown of **mugwort**.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels down the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} onto a *tree* trunk balanced across a stream on two wobbly *stilts*. It is the only **bridge**. The cats refuse to cross, so she forms a human pyramid to make a second **bridge**, and three hundred cats march over her back.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} kitchen, where a soup is boiling over a *blaze*. He keeps adding *water drops*, more and more, until it is ten buckets of soup. He tastes it: so **bland** it tastes like a wet sock. The guests sip and fall asleep from the **bland** soup.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and finds a pile of *feathers* and a *strange mask* shaped like a seagull. She puts on the mask, glues feathers to her arms, and flaps. Each arm becomes a **wing**. She takes off over the waves, but one **wing** is lopsided, so she flies in circles round the ice-cream van.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} into the hall of mirrors, where a *standing heart* gives him a furious *glare*. It stomps, puffs smoke, and kicks the candyfloss stand. "I **hate** clowns!" it shrieks. A clown walks in. The heart's **hate** boils over and it chases him round the dodgems.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and meets an *acrobat* juggling a *silk skein* that keeps unravelling into more and more threads. Threads everywhere, **numerous** as spaghetti. The Firefighter tries to count them and gives up at a million. The acrobat sneezes, and the threads become even more **numerous**, tangling the chandelier.

The {Hunter} stomps up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} in shorts, and someone pulls the *roof* off above him like a lid. A blizzard pours in. It is so **cold** that his moustache freezes into icicles and the portraits grow scarves. He hides under the stairs, but even there it is **cold** enough to freeze his sneezes into snowballs.

The {Baker} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and finds a *standing person* sawn in *half*. "Don't worry," says one half, "I'm just waiting for my **companion**." The other half waddles in from the kitchen. They join up, and the Baker becomes their third **companion**, sharing a loaf three ways.

The {Tailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion}, where a sad statue has a huge open *mouth*. A *right hand* pats it on the back and the statue lets out a giant **sigh** that blows the curtains off the windows. The Tailor sews new curtains, and the statue gives another **sigh** that blows those away too.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} cellar at midnight and waits with his drill. Suddenly a *sunrise* bursts up through the floorboards, a blazing ball of orange. **Dawn**! The roosters scream, the butler drops his tray, and the Dentist has to wear sunglasses to work through the **dawn** shift.

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a *dugout canoe* lying on a pile of cushions, carrying a sad, cracked *heart*. She rows it gently round the dinosaurs. With every stroke the heart grows healthier, the cracks sealing up. By the gift shop it has started to **recover**, and by closing time it has fully **recovered**.

The {Chef} carries a soup tureen up the {Staircase} of the {Tower} into a *royal court* where the queen is sitting with her feet in *water drops*. Every time she sneezes, the water rushes in and out: the **tide**. The Chef's soup goes out with the **tide** and comes back with a crab in it.

The {Lifeguard} runs up the {Staircase} of the {Stadium} carrying a sack of *rice* to a *good meal* laid out for the team. The sack bursts and **grain** rains down on the pitch. Pigeons flood in from every direction. The match is cancelled and the whole crowd eats **grain** porridge in the stands.

The {Sailor} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} and finds a tiny *inn* tied up with *silk thread*. He pulls the thread and the inn starts to **shrink**, smaller and smaller, until it fits in his pocket. Guests wave from the tiny windows. Then the Sailor's hat begins to **shrink** too.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Spa}, and a *dropped net* falls on everyone in the steam room. Nobody can move. "**Stop**!" shouts the manager, and the massage, the music and the bubbles all **stop** together. The Baker sells bread rolls through the holes in the net.

The {Juggler} plunges through the {Trapdoor} into the {Museum} where a *gathering* of statues has come to life. They all **gather** round him in a circle: knights, mummies, a stone horse. He juggles three vases. More statues shuffle in to **gather**, until the room is so packed that the T-rex has to watch from the doorway.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring} and finds a trail of glowing *footsteps* painted on the canvas. He follows the **path**, round the corner post, under the ropes, through the referee's legs. The crowd cheers each step. The **path** finally leads to a door marked EXIT, which is locked.

The {Cheerleader} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Piazza} with a cooking pot and a *fitted lid*. Her *standing heart* thumps as she drops the lid on, and it fits **exactly**, with a perfect click. The crowd gasps. She tries the lid on a fountain, a bell and a pigeon: it fits each one **exactly**.

The {Tailor} perches on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} where a *helping hand* sorts a basket of eggs, each with a *cracked shell*. "**Choose** the best one," says the cat owner. The hand picks one, and out pops a duckling. It picks another: a dragon. The Tailor must **choose** which to sew a tiny jacket for.

The {Dentist} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} hut, where a *stand-in* dentist is stuffing a huge *robe* with seashells to make a **bag**. She ties the sleeves together and hoists it on her back. It rattles like a drum kit. The real Dentist grabs his own **bag**, and they race to fill teeth with shells.

The {Hunter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} and accidentally knocks over the chimney pot. A cloud of *ash* blasts out, covering the patients inside. Everyone is grey as a pigeon. They sneeze **ash**, sit in **ash**, and the receptionist calls their names through a mouthful of soot.

The {Baker} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Pool} building, where a *helping hand* leaps out of a *seedbed* and tries to **catch** a runaway rubber duck. It misses. It grabs again and gets the Baker's apron. Finally it manages to **catch** the duck, the Baker and three lifeguards in one fist.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Museum} so **slowly** that a snail overtakes him. His *footsteps* go thud... thud... thud. He is carrying a tray of *leftovers* from the café and mustn't spill a crumb. By the top the museum has closed, and he walks back down just as **slowly**.

The {Jockey} rides onto the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair}'s ghost train, where a *king* is combing his long, *thick hair*. Out tumbles a glittering **treasure**: rubies, coins and a golden toothbrush. Children scramble for it. The king just keeps combing, and more **treasure** pours out with every stroke.

The {Magician} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} stage and lands behind a thick *grass* **curtain** strung across the diving boards. He pulls it open: the audience cheers, but a hippo is in his spot. He yanks the **curtain** shut, then open again: now the hippo is doing his card trick.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring} carrying a wooden *yoke* hung with two polished pans. The *sun* bounces off them and the light **reflects** into the boxers' eyes. They swing blindly and punch the ropes. The Yogi bows, and the pans **reflect** a sunbeam that pops a balloon in the back row.

The {Lifeguard} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Yeti Cave} and finds a *lineup* of yetis trying on one tiny *robe*. The first yeti pulls it on, flexes and... rip! A huge **crack** splits it from neck to knee. The next yeti tries; another **crack**. Soon the cave walls split too, from all the flexing.

The {Tailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Island} and finds a *spring planter* gently *splashing water* over flowers. A turtle sleeps beside it, smiling. The waves hum. Even the Tailor's needle stops jabbing. Everything is so **peaceful** that a coconut falls slowly, like a feather, and lands without a sound: the most **peaceful** island ever.

The {Gardener} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hut} carrying a giant *cauldron* and plants it on the *hillside* between two arguing goats. It sits there like a wall, to **separate** them. They butt it. Bong! The Gardener adds a second cauldron to **separate** the chickens, then a third for the arguing cabbages.

The {Cheerleader} crouches in the {Basement} of the {Beach} house in front of a locked *door* with a huge *mouth* painted on it. She yells, "**Open**!" The mouth yawns wide and the door swings **open**, letting in a tidal wave of sand, crabs and a lost surfer.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} as a *big man* below sharpens a pencil, scattering *crumbs* of wood. The pencil grows so **sharp** it pokes holes in the clouds. Rain pours through. The Juggler juggles it carefully, but it is so **sharp** it slices his juggling balls into neat halves.

The {Jockey} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} lighthouse, aiming arrows at a *bullseye* painted on a giant *heart*. Every arrow hits dead centre. The heart doesn't flinch: it is **loyal** to him, whatever happens. Even when he misses and hits a pelican, the heart stays **loyal** and pretends it was the bullseye.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Lake} and lands on a towering *yarn pile*. She must knit it all into towels before sunset. Click, click, click. By the last ball she is so **tired** that she falls asleep on the needles. The fish are **tired** of waiting and go knit their own.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and her knee touches a *blaze* on the banister. It swells up red, hot and puffy: a nasty **inflammation**. She sits in an ice bucket. The butler's ankle catches the **inflammation** too, then the dog's tail, until the whole mansion glows like a toaster.

The {Zookeeper} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} kitchen onto a *chopping block* with a tiny *sun* sitting on it. "I'm only here as a **temporary** cook," says the sun, frying eggs on its own face. By evening it sets out the window, and the moon arrives as the next **temporary** chef.

The {Gardener} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building with a *standing person* holding a dusty *antique* vase. "**Estimate** its price!" The Gardener sniffs it, weighs it, licks it. "Five pence." The vase cracks with shame. The standing person holds up a teapot: "Now **estimate** this one."

The {Firefighter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a flooded ballroom full of *water drops*, sitting on a *flat tyre*. It starts to **float**, round and round, past the chandeliers. Butlers paddle by on trays. Even the grand piano begins to **float**, playing a waltz all by itself.

The {Hunter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Swamp} lodge looking out over a *wasteland*. No trees, no frogs, not even mud: just one dry tumbleweed. It's **barren**. He plants a seed; a crow eats it. He plants a tree; a goat eats it. The land stays stubbornly **barren** and the goat looks pleased.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} where a *standing person* is giving a *taste test* to his soup. "Disgusting! You must **repay** me for my tongue!" So the Chef **repays** him: a thousand more spoonfuls, each worse than the last, until the man flies off in the nearest plane.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} treehouse and finds a fallen *tree* lying flat across the steps, an egg *yolk* dripping off it. He tries to climb over it, but it stays **horizontal**. He tries under it. Everything around him turns **horizontal**: the monkeys, the snakes, even the waterfall now flows sideways.

The {Juggler} plunges through the {Trapdoor} into the {Museum} where a *helping hand* holds up a wooden *set square* like a stop sign. "Ticket?" He offers a juggling ball. The hand **refuses**. He offers a pie. It **refuses** again, and pokes him back up the trapdoor with the set square.

The {Robot} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *king* is waiting to see the doctor holding a pot with a single *sprout tip*. The sprout blooms into a four-leaf clover. "How **lucky**!" Everyone's name is called at once. The Robot touches the clover and wins the raffle: a **lucky** day for metal.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut where a *swan* rests its head on a *standing heart*. "I **recall** the day we met," says the heart dreamily, and pictures float above them: sandcastles, sunburn, ice cream. The swan honks. Now the Yogi starts to **recall** everything too, including where she buried her car keys.

The {Gardener} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} building beside a *child* who is alone with one giant *melon*. No friends, no ball, nobody to talk to. It's so **lonely**. The child draws a face on the melon and they chat. The Gardener, now feeling **lonely** himself, draws a face on a cucumber.

The {Baker} is on the {Staircase} of the {Beach} house when a giant *nose* on a wooden *serving stand* sniffs his fresh bread. It sniffs so hard that the loaves shoot up its nostrils. "Give them back!" yells the Baker. The **nose** sneezes them out across the beach. Every gull now has a **nose** for bread.

The {Ninja} sneaks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a *market* squeezed behind an iron *gate*. Vendors shout, chickens squawk, drums bang, a tuba plays. So **noisy**! The Ninja tries to tiptoe, but a goat bleats right in his ear. He covers his ears, but the market only gets more **noisy**.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and finds a *sheep* doing a perfect headstand on a jet's wing. Then twenty more **sheep** arrive and copy the pose. The Yogi joins them, and the pilot comes back to a plane covered in upside-down wool. He sighs and counts every **sheep** before take-off.

The {Dentist} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut beside a patient who gives him a *blank stare*. He tells a joke; the stare stays blank. He juggles coconuts; still **dull**. A parrot does a backflip; the stare doesn't blink. The Dentist falls asleep from how **dull** it all is.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and finds a granite *whetstone* where she sharpens her whistle. Now it shrieks at every tiny mistake. A toe in the wrong lane: whistle! A splash: whistle! She is so **strict** that the waves stand still. Even the sharks swim in neat rows for the **strict** Lifeguard.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} treehouse and arrives at a *crossroads* where an elephant is standing on a balance scale. He has to **weigh** it against a mountain of bananas. One banana too many: crash. He pulls one off and tries to **weigh** it again, while monkeys steal bananas from the other side.

The {Baker} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} under the *moon*, which is wrapped in a little brown *parcel* tied with string. Inside, curled up warm, sleeps a baby star. "It was safe in the **womb**," whispers the Baker. He rocks the parcel gently, like a **womb** made of paper.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} as a *herald* in a feathered cap reads the score in the *rain*. "Champion: nine. Challenger: **zero**!" The challenger slumps. Raindrops form a giant 0 on the canvas. Everyone stares at it. The herald adds another **zero** to the challenger's prize money.

The {Cheerleader} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Youth Club} into a damp *cave*, where a *strong arm* sticks out of the wall holding out an empty bowl. Not a penny, not a crumb: it's so **poor**. She shakes her pompoms and coins fall out. The arm pockets them, then pretends to be **poor** again.

The {Sheriff} kicks open the {Basement} door of the {Hut}, but the *hut* itself sighs and starts walking away on chicken legs. "I **give up**," it groans, "too many sheriffs." She tries to lasso it, but it hops over the fence. Finally she sits down too and decides to **give up**.

The {Magician} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Spa} where a *horse* is stamping a *stone* tablet with its hoof. Each stamp leaves a **number**: 1, 7, 42. The guests' lockers open whenever the horse hits the right **number**. The Magician guesses 13 and gets a bucket of mud.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and lands in front of a giant warrior with glowing *red cheeks*, two shining suns on his face. He flexes, and the whole hut lights up. "**Impressive**!" says the Hunter, shielding his eyes. The warrior blushes even redder, which is even more **impressive**.

The {Pirate} sprints up the {Staircase} of the {Fort}, but an old *woman* on a surfboard rides a giant *wave* straight up the steps behind him. "Out of my way, young man!" She knocks him into a cannon. The **granny** fires the cannon herself. The Pirate decides never to race a **granny** again.

The {Hunter} tiptoes down the {Staircase} of the {Casino} when a wispy *ghost* drifts out of a slot machine, riding a little *cloud*. It is the **soul** of a gambler who never won. The Hunter feeds it a coin. Jackpot! The **soul** whoops, spins three times, and floats away on its cloud.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut when a monkey lights a *campfire* right beneath the *roof*. Sparks fly, the thatch catches, parrots scream. **Disaster**! The Zookeeper pours a bucket of water, which turns out to be lemonade. Now the island is sticky as well as smoking: double **disaster**.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} hut as *joined hands* of a hundred villagers try to hold back the *water drops*. Too late: a **flood** pours over them. Boats float through the kitchen, fish swim through the bedroom. The Hunter surfs down the stairs on a door, riding the **flood**.
